approval.rationale: The current Safe Purge v0.1 implementation remains approved. This design-only revision prospectively authorizes read-only cross-policy lifecycle reconciliation and additive market-vault-safe-purge-plan-v4 evidence when EXACT_SCOPE materially excludes a prior VERIFIED_QUARANTINED unit. Historical v2 EXACT_SCOPE and v3 SUPERSEDED_ONLY meanings, the existing mutation owner, exact confirmation, lifecycle lock, persistent mutation types, destructive signals, and occurrence counts remain unchanged. A later implementation PR must contain this approved contract in its exact base.

identity.name: Safe Purge v0.1
identity.purpose: Move exact, sealed market-bar Raw and Curated physical snapshot pairs, selected by explicit EXACT_SCOPE or SUPERSEDED_ONLY planning and discovered through authoritative per-symbol registry bindings or unchanged legacy run bindings, out of active archive globs into same-volume quarantine without permanent deletion. Prospectively, EXACT_SCOPE may use a sealed v4 plan to exclude historical units only after read-only proof that the exact pair is already VERIFIED_QUARANTINED by an earlier committed Safe Purge operation.

implementation_bindings.rationale: The purge planning entry point owns the reviewed Safe Purge plan surface.
The purge execution entry point owns exact-confirmation execution and its reviewed staging cleanup.
The physical movement helper owns one reviewed no-overwrite rename and one reviewed rollback unlink surface.
The terminal evidence publisher owns one reviewed no-replace rename and one reviewed staging cleanup surface.
The public Python API delegates purge requests to the service-owned Safe Purge boundary.
The Console backend exposes only reviewed preview, exact-confirmation execution, and stale-preview invalidation.
The production PySide6/QML Storage & Cleanup controller exposes only the reviewed exact-confirmation execution entry point and must delegate all mutation authority to ConsoleBackend and Safe Purge.
The Catalog stores the purge lifecycle index and owns the atomic durable SUCCESS transition, while immutable JSON remains detailed evidence.

initiators: MarketVault.purge_plan callers selecting explicit cleanup policy and MarketVault.purge_execute callers
market-vault purge-plan and purge-execute CLI callers
Production PySide6/QML Storage & Cleanup review and exact-confirmation execute actions through StorageCleanupController and ConsoleBackend
forbidden_bypass_layers: Production PySide6/QML presentation must not mutate Parquet, quarantine, or DuckDB directly
StorageCleanupController must not move, unlink, or rename files; write purge Catalog state; construct purge success evidence; or decide that a plan is safe to execute
API adapters must not move files outside purge_execute
storage helpers must not authorize an unsealed or stale plan
SUPERSEDED_ONLY planning must not introduce a second latest-snapshot algorithm or any destructive executor outside purge_execute
Cross-policy reconciliation is read-only evidence interpretation and must not move files, rewrite historical Catalog paths, publish an absent terminal result, or create lifecycle state
Only purge_execute may act on an explicitly reviewed v4 plan; no reconciliation helper may become a second mutation or result-publication authority

mutated_assets: Complete Raw and Curated market_bars Parquet pairs sealed by registered (run_id, symbol) binding or legacy ingestion-run binding and selected by the plan's explicit cleanup policy
Same-volume quarantine paths preserving original data-root-relative paths
Immutable purge plan, precommit, and result JSON evidence
DuckDB market-bar views refreshed after movement or rollback
excluded_assets: Ingestion runs, market_bar_snapshot_pairs rows, collection manifests, and quality reports
The exact retained complete winner for every SUPERSEDED_ONLY logical key
Failed, running, orphaned, unregistered, metadata-mismatched, quality-failed, or otherwise unverifiable market-bar snapshots
Arbitrary external user paths and consumers
Historical ingestion-run and market_bar_snapshot_pairs path values, which remain original collection provenance after quarantine
Derived ACTIVE, VERIFIED_QUARANTINED, MISSING_UNEXPLAINED, AMBIGUOUS, and INVALID lifecycle interpretations, which are not persisted as new Catalog state

allowed_transitions.rationale: Planning may seal a non-executable refusal when physical scope or evidence is unsafe.
An exact confirmed executable plan may begin under the lifecycle lock.
A non-committed failed attempt may retry after all sealed identities are revalidated.
A pre-commit failure records non-success evidence after rollback is attempted.
Only the atomic Catalog commit with precommit and result hashes makes success authoritative.

forbidden_transitions.rationale: A completed exact plan is handled as an idempotent read and publication recovery, not restarted mutation.
Post-commit publication failure cannot roll back or demote the authoritative Catalog commit.
A refused sealed plan is never executable.
SUCCESS cannot be assigned without a new EXECUTING attempt and atomic commit.

commit_point.durable_authority: Catalog.commit_purge_operation atomically changes the exact EXECUTING row to SUCCESS and binds plan hash, immutable precommit path, terminal result path, result hash, and completion time.
commit_point.success_authoritative_when: The Catalog SUCCESS transaction commits only after all planned files are in verified quarantine and immutable precommit evidence seals the complete canonical terminal result.

pre_commit: A crash may leave some sealed files in quarantine and a Catalog state other than SUCCESS.
A pre-commit failure attempts reverse-order rollback and refreshes active market-bar views.
Immutable precommit evidence is non-terminal and must never by itself prove SUCCESS.
One-sided, unregistered, orphaned-registry, or partially published multi-symbol collection evidence is not a valid registered physical pair and is refused rather than guessed.
A new-format symbol is not successful and cannot populate compatibility pointers until Raw and Curated publication, exact-pair verification, and exact registry insertion all succeed.
Every new-format run durably records snapshot_binding_mode REGISTERED_PER_SYMBOL even when it publishes zero pairs, so missing registry evidence cannot create legacy authority.

A SUPERSEDED_ONLY precommit must seal both every target pair and the exact retained active winner for each affected logical key; failure before Catalog SUCCESS rolls moved targets back without changing the sealed winner.
post_commit: Rollback is no longer legal after Catalog SUCCESS commits.
A crash may leave only non-terminal staging residue while the final result path remains absent.
An exact retry reconstructs and atomically publishes the precommitted terminal bytes after revalidation.

Read-only reconciliation may accept an absent final result only when Catalog SUCCESS, the canonical precommit, its embedded terminal result and hash, and both quarantine identities form the complete committed-success chain.
The reconciliation reader never publishes an absent result; publication recovery remains exclusively an idempotent purge_execute retry.

restorable: Before commit, files moved by the current attempt are moved back to their sealed active paths in reverse order.
A duplicated POSIX link created before unlink failure is removed only after both names and hashes verify.
non_restorable: After Catalog SUCCESS, automatic rollback is prohibited because quarantine is authoritative.
Safe Purge v0.1 provides no restore operation and no permanent deletion operation.
interruption_detection: Catalog EXECUTING or FAILED state cannot be interpreted as SUCCESS.
Catalog SUCCESS with absent terminal result triggers exact precommit-based publication recovery.
Read-only lifecycle reconciliation may validate the exact committed precommit chain without triggering publication recovery.
Any quarantine, Catalog, plan, precommit, or result identity conflict fails closed.

same_request_retry: The same sealed plan ID is reloaded and content-hash verified.
A failed non-committed attempt may retry only after exact active or quarantine identities and Catalog run bindings verify.
Registered targets additionally require an unchanged exact market_bar_snapshot_pairs binding.
A SUPERSEDED_ONLY retry requires the same cleanup policy, logical-key groups, target bindings, retained-winner bindings, and deterministic ranking facts.
A v4 EXACT_SCOPE retry requires every sealed reconciled unit to remain VERIFIED_QUARANTINED through the same prior committed plan, precommit, terminal-result hash, and quarantine identities.
completed_retry: A Catalog SUCCESS retry performs no market-data movement.
A byte-identical existing final result is accepted; an absent final is republished from the immutable precommit.
Final-result publication after v4 Review is not drift when it publishes the exact precommitted bytes and hash; final-result presence is not sealed as destructive authority.
conflicting_retry: A different plan hash, cleanup policy, scope, run binding, snapshot-pair registry binding, retained-winner binding, deterministic ranking result, reconciled lifecycle unit, prior purge authority, quarantine identity, precommit, Catalog result hash, or final result is refused without overwrite.

lock_authority: MarketBarLifecycleLock uses exclusive atomic directory creation under the configured data root and never auto-reclaims stale locks.
lock_scope: purge_execute holds the market-bar lifecycle lock across revalidation, movement, Catalog commit, publication attempt, rollback, and view refresh.
collect_history and operation-wide collect_history_backfill use the same lifecycle boundary.
under_lock_revalidation: Every planned ingestion run and Raw/Curated identity is re-resolved before mutation.
Registered targets re-prove run-level snapshot_binding_mode REGISTERED_PER_SYMBOL, then re-resolve the exact (run_id, symbol) market_bar_snapshot_pairs row and compare every field.
Every explicit or historical implicit legacy target re-proves null snapshot_binding_mode and zero market_bar_snapshot_pairs rows for the run before mutation.
Matching RUNNING runs, unregistered matching files, and unplanned matching active snapshots are refused.

SUPERSEDED_ONLY execution re-enumerates complete snapshots for every exact source, code, requested trade date, interval, requested session, adjustment, and source schema version key; reuses the Catalog latest-complete ranking; and proves every sealed retained winner is unchanged, active, complete, and still the unique winner before movement.

SUPERSEDED_ONLY execution refuses if a newly completed snapshot changes the winner, any sealed winner disappears or drifts, or any legacy pair is not fully superseded for every physically co-located symbol.

V4 EXACT_SCOPE execution revalidates every sealed prior plan, precommit, embedded terminal result and Catalog hash, both quarantine files, historical run or registry binding, and absence of conflicting success authority before the first new movement.
V4 EXACT_SCOPE execution refuses when any sealed VERIFIED_QUARANTINED unit becomes missing, ambiguous, invalid, active, or otherwise differs from the reviewed lifecycle classification.
concurrent_behavior: A concurrent supported market-bar writer or purge cannot acquire the lock and must fail closed.
Read-only queries may fail or retry during transition but must not infer missing active data as successful purge evidence.

identities: Exact plan ID, canonical plan content hash, cleanup policy, scope, target list, retained-winner list when applicable, and plan-file location

Exact ingestion run ID, snapshot_binding_mode, status, requested and successful symbols, legacy pointer values including nulls, date, interval, requested session, adjustment, and configuration identity
For registered targets, the exact market_bar_snapshot_pairs run ID, symbol, date, interval, session, adjustment, source, schema version, Raw path, Curated path, and row count
For explicit LEGACY_INGESTION_RUN and historical v2 targets without binding_mode, exact null snapshot_binding_mode plus an empty market_bar_snapshot_pairs result for the run
Every target relative path, byte size, SHA-256, row count, symbols, dates, and request-key facts

For SUPERSEDED_ONLY, each exact logical key consisting of source, code, requested trade date, interval, requested session, adjustment, and source schema version; every target-to-retained run mapping; retained Raw and Curated identity; snapshot_ingested_at, run_finished_at, ingestion_run_id, and snapshot_file ranking facts; and proof that one complete active winner remains

For v4 EXACT_SCOPE, cleanup_policy EXACT_SCOPE and every reconciled_quarantined_units entry binding the historical physical unit, original Raw and Curated identities, exact request identity, prior supported plan version and policy, plan path and hash, precommit path and hash, expected terminal-result path and hash, exact moved entries, and same-plan quarantine destinations
Active and quarantine file identity, same-filesystem destination, and absence of unplanned matching snapshots
drift_behavior: Any missing, changed, one-sided, co-located, unregistered, unsafe, newly matching, unknown-mode, mode-drifted, or otherwise unprovable identity refuses before additional mutation.

A SUPERSEDED_ONLY plan refuses before mutation when the deterministic winner differs from the sealed winner, a retained winner is no longer complete or active, a new complete version appears, a matching RUNNING writer or unregistered snapshot appears, or movement could leave zero complete active snapshots for any affected key.

A v4 EXACT_SCOPE plan refuses before mutation when prior authority is absent, non-success, malformed, noncanonical, hash-conflicting, path-unsafe, incomplete, cross-scope, claimed by multiple successful operations, split across operations, or inconsistent with active state.
Execution never rewrites or splits immutable Parquet to satisfy narrower logical scope.

authoritative_evidence: Catalog purge_operations state SUCCESS with exact plan hash, precommit path, final result path, result hash, and completion timestamp
Immutable precommit containing the complete canonical proposed terminal result and matching result hash
Complete canonical final result atomically published without replacement, or recoverably absent immediately after commit

For VERIFIED_QUARANTINED interpretation, one non-conflicting supported prior plan whose exact Raw and Curated moved entries match historical binding and whose same-plan quarantine files verify by safe path, SHA-256, byte size, and physical facts
non_success_evidence: PLANNED, REFUSED, EXECUTING, or FAILED Catalog state
Plan JSON, failure result JSON, precommit JSON, staging residue, or quarantined files without Catalog SUCCESS
A partial, malformed, hash-conflicting, or unflushed terminal result
A quarantine pathname, a Catalog SUCCESS row without its complete integrity chain, or only one side of a Raw and Curated pair
integrity_binding: Canonical JSON bytes bind every terminal result field including message and timestamps to SHA-256.
Catalog result_hash and immutable precommit terminal_result_hash must equal the canonical final bytes.
Atomic no-replace publication never overwrites a conflicting final result.

If the final result exists it must equal the precommitted terminal bytes; if absent, read-only reconciliation relies on the Catalog-bound precommit chain without publishing or treating absence as authority drift.

invalidation_triggers: Any production PySide6/QML Storage & Cleanup cleanup_policy, source, symbols, start date, end date, interval, session, adjustment, or schema modification after Review invalidates the Python controller's reviewed plan and exact scope fingerprint.
confirmation_invalidation: Production PySide6/QML cleanup-policy or scope modification clears confirmation and disables Execute until a new Review succeeds; QML enabled state is presentation only.
execution_policy: Execution requires the exact text PURGE followed by one space and the sealed plan ID.
The production StorageCleanupController retains the current reviewed plan ID, executable state, exact scope fingerprint, invalidation state, confirmation validity, and execute eligibility in Python.

StorageCleanupController rejects execution when no executable review exists, the plan ID or scope differs, review is invalidated, or confirmation is not exact, even if QML presentation state is wrong.
ConsoleBackend independently rechecks its current reviewed plan and reloads the plan rather than trusting mutable widget state.
purge_execute independently retains exact confirmation and sealed-plan revalidation authority.

EXACT_SCOPE remains the default; historical market-vault-safe-purge-plan-v2 evidence without cleanup_policy always means EXACT_SCOPE and remains executable under its original rules; SUPERSEDED_ONLY requires v3 with explicit policy and sealed retained-winner evidence; and EXACT_SCOPE that materially excludes at least one VERIFIED_QUARANTINED unit requires v4 with explicit policy and sealed reconciliation evidence.
Ordinary active-only EXACT_SCOPE may continue emitting v2, and no new QML destructive control or layout is authorized for v4.

lifecycle_unit: For a run whose snapshot_binding_mode is REGISTERED_PER_SYMBOL, each exact registered per-symbol Raw plus Curated pair is one minimum physical lifecycle unit; zero rows means no authoritative pair.

For a null-mode run with zero registry rows, the complete legacy ingestion_runs Raw plus Curated pair remains the minimum physical lifecycle unit only while null mode and zero rows are re-proven at execution.
New-format successful_symbols, snapshot_pairs, and compatibility pointers are derived exclusively from verified registered pairs.

SUPERSEDED_ONLY groups only COMPLETE snapshots by exact source, code, requested trade date, interval, requested session, adjustment, and source schema version and retains exactly one winner per key using snapshot_ingested_at DESC NULLS LAST, run_finished_at DESC NULLS LAST, ingestion_run_id DESC, and snapshot_file DESC.

Cross-policy reconciliation derives ACTIVE, VERIFIED_QUARANTINED, MISSING_UNEXPLAINED, AMBIGUOUS, or INVALID from existing evidence without adding Catalog lifecycle state or rewriting original provenance paths.

REGISTERED_PER_SYMBOL reconciliation applies only to the exact (run_id, symbol) pair; legacy reconciliation applies to the entire indivisible Raw and Curated pair and all physically contained symbols through one prior authority.
partial_mutation: A one-sided pair or partial symbol/date/request-key selection within a legacy co-located file refuses the entire plan.
Registered discovery never falls back to legacy pointers, and an unregistered intersecting active file refuses the entire plan.
A registry insertion failure after physical publication leaves non-success unregistered evidence and never creates compatibility pointers or implicit legacy authority.
A registered-mode run never falls back to compatibility pointers after a registry row disappears, and a null-mode run with registry rows is refused as inconsistent authority.
SUPERSEDED_ONLY may target one exact registered (run_id, symbol) pair without targeting siblings only when that pair is independently complete and superseded for its exact logical key.

A legacy multi-symbol Raw and Curated pair may be targeted only when every physically contained symbol has a different newer COMPLETE retained winner for its own exact logical key; otherwise the whole plan refuses with LEGACY_PAIR_NOT_FULLY_SUPERSEDED or an equivalent dedicated code.
An interrupted multi-file move remains non-success until rollback or committed recovery completes.
rollback_expectation: Before commit, every file moved by the attempt is rolled back when safely provable.
Rollback uncertainty is reported and never converted into terminal SUCCESS.

retained_dependents: Committed Verified Canonical builds with embedded source hashes and provenance
Committed Dataset artifacts that verify without reloading Canonical
Committed Dataset Catalog snapshots that verify without reloading recorded Dataset paths
Ingestion runs, market_bar_snapshot_pairs rows, collection manifests, and quality reports
refused_cases: Missing, conflicting, orphaned, or drifted per-symbol registry binding
A registered pair whose symbol is absent from successful_symbols or whose run is absent, non-terminal, or request-inconsistent
A legacy plan whose run gains any market_bar_snapshot_pairs row after planning
A registered-mode run with a missing required registry row, a null-mode run with registry rows, any unknown non-null mode, or any mode change after planning
Co-located symbols, dates, or request-key facts outside the exact requested scope

A SUPERSEDED_ONLY candidate that is not COMPLETE, is the retained winner, lacks a newer COMPLETE winner for the exact logical key, or belongs to a legacy pair whose every symbol is not independently superseded

A SUPERSEDED_ONLY plan with a changed winner, newly complete matching version, missing or drifted retained winner, matching RUNNING run, matching unregistered file, or post-movement proof that fewer than one complete active snapshot would remain

A v4 EXACT_SCOPE reconciliation with unexplained missing bytes, active and quarantine conflict, conflicting successful claims, split Raw and Curated authority, incomplete quarantine, evidence tampering, unknown evidence schema, or request identity mismatch
Wildcard scope, arbitrary paths, path drift, Catalog drift, or unverified reparse points
unsupported_cases: Cascade mutation of Canonical, Dataset, or Dataset Catalog artifacts
Discovery or lifecycle guarantees for arbitrary external user code and paths
A second destructive executor or a latest-snapshot ranking separate from the Catalog completion authority
Restore, garbage collection, quarantine expiry, and permanent deletion

permanent_deletion.rationale: Safe Purge v0.1 only moves exact immutable snapshot pairs into retained same-volume quarantine and exposes no permanent-delete command or API.

implementation_tests: Exact whole-physical-batch and complete co-located multi-symbol legacy purge succeeds
An exact registered symbol pair can be purged independently from a multi-symbol logical run without moving sibling pairs
Single-symbol and partial multi-symbol registry insertion failures never publish unregistered files as successful, compatible, or legacy pairs
Registered-mode single-symbol pointer fallback is refused after registry loss, including zero-pair new-format runs
Explicit and historical implicit legacy targets refuse when run mode becomes non-null or any registry row appears after planning
Partial legacy co-located scope, unregistered snapshots, one-sided pairs, registry or run drift, bad confirmation, tampering, reparse paths, and lock conflicts refuse
Pre-commit failures roll back without terminal SUCCESS evidence
Post-commit terminal publication interruption recovers exact canonical bytes idempotently
Existing committed Canonical, Dataset, and Dataset Catalog artifacts remain independently verifiable after source quarantine
Production QML scope changes invalidate Review and confirmation
Production QML scope mutation invalidates the Python controller's reviewed plan state and confirmation
Production QML execution rejects stale scope even when presentation enabled state is wrong
Production QML execution rejects a wrong plan ID
Production QML execution rejects incorrect exact confirmation
Production QML execution delegates through ConsoleBackend and does not mutate files directly
An exact valid production QML reviewed plan can execute only through existing Safe Purge authority
SUPERSEDED_ONLY with one complete snapshot for an exact logical key produces zero targets
SUPERSEDED_ONLY with two or three complete versions retains exactly the Catalog-ranked latest winner and targets only the older complete versions
Session, adjustment, interval, source, and source schema version differences produce separate logical-key groups
A failed, quality-FAIL, running, orphaned, unregistered, or otherwise incomplete newer snapshot does not supersede an older complete snapshot
A PARTIAL run may supply a complete registered symbol only through the existing completion predicate and exact registry authority
A matching unregistered snapshot or RUNNING run refuses SUPERSEDED_ONLY planning and execution
A changed, disappeared, inactive, quality-invalid, or newly displaced retained winner refuses execution before mutation
Target or retained Raw and Curated SHA-256, size, path, run, registry, request, or physical-fact drift refuses execution
A legacy multi-symbol pair is targetable only when every contained symbol is superseded; one unsuperseded symbol retains and refuses the whole pair
Successful SUPERSEDED_ONLY execution leaves the exact sealed winner active and queryable for every affected key and quarantines only sealed superseded pairs
EXACT_SCOPE behavior and historical sealed market-vault-safe-purge-plan-v2 execution remain unchanged; missing cleanup_policy means EXACT_SCOPE and cannot authorize SUPERSEDED_ONLY
Changing cleanup_policy or any existing scope field invalidates Review, clears confirmation, and requires a new plan
Three complete versions followed by successful SUPERSEDED_ONLY quarantine produce a v4 EXACT_SCOPE plan targeting only the remaining active version and sealing both prior quarantines
Executing that v4 plan moves only the remaining active pair; a repeated review is REFUSED with NO_MATCHING_DATA and zero targets when all historical units are VERIFIED_QUARANTINED
Missing active files without committed-success evidence remain MISSING_UNEXPLAINED and refuse
Missing either quarantine side, quarantine hash or size drift, prior plan or precommit tampering, Catalog hash conflict, unsafe evidence paths, and unknown prior schemas refuse
PLANNED, REFUSED, EXECUTING, FAILED, precommit-only, staging-only, partial-quarantine, and rolled-back evidence never establish VERIFIED_QUARANTINED
Catalog SUCCESS with an absent final result reconciles read-only only through the valid precommit chain and never invokes publication recovery
A later exact publication of precommitted terminal bytes does not invalidate a v4 plan, while any conflicting final result refuses
Registered sibling symbols reconcile independently, and legacy co-located symbols reconcile only as one indivisible pair through the same authority
Requested session, source, symbol, requested trade date, interval, adjustment, and source schema version remain exact reconciliation boundaries
Quarantine evidence drift or a new matching active or unregistered snapshot after Review refuses v4 execution before movement
Historical v2 EXACT_SCOPE and v3 SUPERSEDED_ONLY plans retain their exact loaders and execution semantics
A successful v4 EXACT_SCOPE operation may serve as future reconciliation authority only through the same complete committed-success chain
